nodes.label: D0 No Crashes Guaranteed
nodes.rationale: Top priority directive; wins every conflict. A safer version is always chosen over a faster/prettier one. Risks checked against decompiled vanilla limits.

nodes.label: D2 Co-op Compatibility
nodes.rationale: Server decides NPC/world/random outcomes; player projectiles owner-only; ai[] synced, localAI not; tested SP, host+client, dedicated.

nodes.label: D5 Visual Proof (GIF)
nodes.rationale: Anything that moves needs a GIF built from frames or an offline simulation using real sprites and constants; in-game capture is optional; must be self-reviewed.

nodes.label: PacketRegistry
nodes.rationale: Byte packet id (<=256 types); catches exceptions and drops malformed packets.

nodes.label: SafeGenPass
nodes.rationale: Catches exceptions so world creation continues.

nodes.label: WorldFlagSystem
nodes.rationale: Saves flags by name (never numeric id) and syncs on WorldData.

nodes.label: SceneOverlayRegistry (Core/Hooks)
nodes.rationale: The single reflection touch in the codebase, isolated in Core/Hooks for the 1.4.5 port.

nodes.label: Core/Content Slice Architecture
nodes.rationale: Chosen 2026-10-20 after comparing Calamity (type-based), Starlight River (Core + type-based Content) and Spirit Reforged (feature-based). Core is engine with no content; Content/<Slice>/ per feature; slices never reach into each other.

nodes.label: Vent Keybind
nodes.rationale: World effect is an owner-spawned projectile (auto-synced), not a direct NPC hit.

nodes.label: Junkyard Vanilla Region Replacement
nodes.rationale: Keep vanilla structures out instead of shrinking around them (2026-10-22): JunkyardLayoutPass mirrors the Dungeon right, JunkyardReservePass claims footprint via AddProtectedStructure, ShimmerPlacementPass replaces vanilla Shimmer with fallback. Same slot as Calamity's Sulphurous Sea.

nodes.label: Biome Liquid via ModWaterStyle (Tar)
nodes.rationale: No ModLiquid in 1.4.4 (LiquidID.Count = 4), so tar is vanilla water restyled the Calamity way plus a ModPlayer applying effects while wet in the biome.

nodes.label: CogpunkSets.ScrappyTrunkTrinket
nodes.rationale: Scrappy Trunks replace 20% of Wooden Chests and hold pre-Hardmode non-boss trinkets.

nodes.label: Attack-Pattern Fairness Rules
nodes.rationale: Telegraph >=30/20/12 ticks by tier; T0-T4 dodgeable without wings; hostile effects Ember/Steam, friendly Brass/Aether for readability in 4-player fights.

nodes.label: 1.4.5 Port Readiness
nodes.rationale: Prefer public hooks; IL edits, detours and reflection are last resort and live in Core/Hooks with justification.

nodes.label: Steam Pressure Resource (Vent/Overheat)
nodes.rationale: Risk/reward: build pressure for damage, vent for burst, overheat as a penalty for greed.
